entry.name: receive
entry.description: Receives and outputs messages from send objects sharing the same name. This allows you to send any kind of message between Patcher windows or within a window without using patch cords. A receive object can be instantiated with its short-form: the letter "r".

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: Name theobject. If there is no argument,has one inlet, and a name must be provided by amessage before anything can be received. Allobjects that share the same name will receive data from anyobjects that share their name.If you want a named/object in a Max for Live device to be unique to the device, use three dashes () to start the name of your/destination (e.g.).When your patch is initialized, it will replace the three dashes with a unique-to-Live number (e.g.);
